suite: No record has a lineage association. 15 of 16 hold only SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to themselves; CAR_KUWAITOILFIRE_BRDF points to "KUWAITOILFIRE_BRDF.2", which is not a CMR ShortName.
None of the 16 CAR_*_L1C siblings, nor SNEX17_CAR, CLAMS_CV580_CAR, CAR_BRDF_709 or the LaRC CAR collections, has any association either.
Every BRDF record's DATA SET LANDING PAGE points to an unrelated GES DISC dataset (GLDAS, GPM, OMI, MERRA-2, ...); the L1C records sampled show the same problem.
No ATBD is linked; the only readable documentation is the shared README. The linked publication (Gatebe & King 2016) is paywalled.
Three campaigns (SAFARI, DISCOVER-AQ, FIRE-ACE) have BRDF flights with no L1C file.
